articleText:
Is Claude down? Login errors hit claude.ai on Friday, and Anthropic says a fix is in Nacionale

Is Claude AI Down? Anthropic Confirms Authentication Issues Across Multiple Services Jagran Josh
reactions: [Hacker News] For me, it seems to work now, but the incident is now being investigated via https://status.claude.com/incidents/nn11wk485zfn UPDATE: it doesn't work again; so the issue is persistent
[Hacker News] Anthropic has been generous with their free usage resets for the metering bug, I wouldn't mind a few more.
[Hacker News] claude.ai Major Outage Claude Console (platform.claude.com) Partial Outage Claude Code Partial Outage Claude Cowork Degraded Performance — Claude API (api.anthropic.com) Operational
[Hacker News] Yeah, it stopped working for me for a few minutes, showing that Cloudflare blocked it. Later on, I changed the Wi-Fi and it's working again.
